Our work

Every shower below was built by Vince and the same two-man crew — no subs, no rotating trades, and no photos borrowed from a manufacturer's catalog. Look past the tile for a second and check the things that actually take skill: how the grout lines land where a wall meets a bench, whether the pan drain sits centred in the mosaic, and how the glass meets the curb. Those are the details that separate a shower still looking right in twenty years from one that gets torn out in five.
